parameters.content:
## START HERE: ServiceTitan Dispatch & Capacity Copilot (DRAFT v0.1.0)
Four read-only dispatch reports for an Operations Manager, delivered to the OWNER only: (1) Booking QA & skill-tier routing, (2) open-capacity & unsold-estimate callback queue, (3) Morning Dispatch KPI digest, (4) after-hours handoff.

**Do these in order:**
1. Import this file (done). It is inactive, and the Schedule node is switched off.
2. Leave **source** = test and click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. The result is a [TEST] message built from fictional HVAC / plumbing / electrical sample data.
3. Compare it with sample_test_digest.md.
4. Switch to **csv** (your own ServiceTitan report exports) and re-run. Still [TEST].
5. Only then think about go-live. See the Go live note.

Status: DRAFT. Designed from public ServiceTitan docs and checked as importable JSON. NOT tested against a live ServiceTitan, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional data, default) | csv (read exports from csvFolder) | servicetitan (live read-only GETs). Anything else falls back to test.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer.
- **stApiBase / stTenantId / stAppKey**: paste-here placeholders for the live path. Unused unless source = servicetitan.
- **csvFolder**: folder with technicians.csv, jobs.csv, capacity.csv, memberships.csv, estimates.csv, calls.csv. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder.
- **asOfOverride**: optional ISO time to pretend it is a different moment (needed to run old exports). Blank = now.
- Thresholds: replacementAgeYears, membershipOverdueDays, estimateStaleDays, bookingLookbackHours, repeatWindowDays, capacityLookaheadDays, afterHoursStartHour (17 = 5 PM), maxItemsPerSection, historyDays. digestHour is informational; the Schedule node sets the real time (7:00 AM).

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**; Schedule **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test**.
- **Read-only**: ServiceTitan nodes are GET only. No POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE.
- **No customer messages**: there is no SMS, no Twilio, and no customer email node anywhere in this file.
- The callback queue is a **draft list for dispatchers**. A person decides who to call.
- Booking QA **suggests** routing. It never reassigns a job.
- Never invents numbers. A metric that cannot be computed becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## Live path: ServiceTitan v2 REST reads (all GET). UNVERIFIED against a real tenant.
Base: {stApiBase}/{module}/v2/tenant/{tenantId}/... plus header ST-App-Key. Auth is an n8n OAuth2 credential (client credentials) named PLACEHOLDER_SERVICETITAN; n8n fetches the token, so this workflow never POSTs to ServiceTitan.
Jobs: jpm/v2/.../jobs | Appointments: jpm/v2/.../appointments | Appointment assignments: dispatch/v2/.../appointment-assignments | Technicians: settings/v2/.../technicians | Technician shifts: dispatch/v2/.../technician-shifts | Estimates: sales/v2/.../estimates | Recurring service events (membership due dates): memberships/v2/.../recurring-service-events | Calls: telecom/v3/.../calls
The Dispatch capacity query is a POST, so it is NOT used. Open windows are derived as shift time minus booked appointments. Exact paths, query names, response fields, and API-version numbers are from public docs and memory and must be confirmed before use. Customer names, phones, equipment, and customer type need extra lookups this draft does not make. First page only (pageSize 200).

## CSV export fallback (recommended first step)
Export your own reports to the six CSV files named in the Config note, drop them in csvFolder, set source = csv, and set asOfOverride if the export is not from today. This path only READS files. See fixtures/ in the pack for the exact columns. Source = test uses the same fictional files, built in.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_SERVICETITAN (OAuth2, live path only), PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL, PLACEHOLDER_SLACK. Attach your own. No secrets, client IDs, or tenant IDs are stored in this file. Do not paste real ones into Config and then share the workflow.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or switch the Schedule on until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from sample data, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR csv export, spot-checked by hand against ServiceTitan, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner. It will not contact customers or change ServiceTitan.
